units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a">Ab. Zar. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מכה דב׳</he> an external wound.—(Adv.) <cite ref="Zevachim 15a:4">Zeb. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>דקאי זר ב׳</he> the layman stands outside.
<cite ref="Zevachim 15a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>לב׳ נפיק וכ׳</he> does (the blood) run only outside (away from the altar) and not also inside (in all directions)?
